subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, and what limits should apply to media kind, TTL, visibility, and local-path exposure?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the repair changes how bystander group attachments can enter later model context, so automation should not choose that privacy/security boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded image retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image `HistoryEntry.media` for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through existing recent-history image handling under current group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep text-only history
options.body: Preserve the safer current behavior and document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed unless it is part of the current or visible reply turn.

options.title: Require live design proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a proposed PR demonstrates the exact Telegram failure and bounded retention behavior with redacted live proof.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded image retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image `HistoryEntry.media` for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it through existing recent-history image handling under current group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision hinges on the unmentioned Telegram media pre-download skip that joshavant introduced and proved in the current behavior.
